title: Case Manager - Legal Writer
description:
Job description


U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, case manager- Legal Writer to join our team.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Communicate with client - Client communication and excellent customer service is key at the Law Office of Jacob Sapochnick
  • Serving as primary point of contact for clients , conducting initial meetings with clients, explain immigration process, requirements, providing regular updates on the case.
  • Document Collection - Review and analyze client documents. Assemble cases for filing, prepare and organize exhibits.
  • Ensure that clients understand the strategy and steps of the process and lead status updates calls with clients.
  • Be proactive and raising any issues that might delay the petition and report it to attorney and senior legal specialists.
  • Reviewing documentation provided by clients and make sure that client has been informed about all missing documents in advance.
  • Working closely with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand the strategy of the case and make sure it is implemented and making sure that the petition is ready in advance for the mid and final reviews of the attorney and that cases are submitted timely.


Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills, grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


· B.A. Degree in Law or English or related studies student or graduate.


· Previous legal or immigration experience preferred.


· High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


· Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


· Be comfortable with phone calls and video calls.


· Applicant must have the ability to use MS Excel, MS Outlook, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat Professional.


Compensation: $ - $ monthly + regular bonuses


Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work or office work

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir na zona norte do Rio de Janeiro.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

description:
Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados com atuação na implementação de soluções com IA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
  • Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
  • Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
  • Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
  • Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises e


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
  • Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
  • Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
  • Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
  • Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
  • Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
  • Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.

title: Estagiário de Assuntos Regulatórios
description:
A Sherwin-Williams é uma multinacional líder global no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países. Com mais de 80 anos de atuação no Brasil, temos o compromisso de oferecer soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade em tintas, atendendo às mais diversas necessidades dos nossos clientes.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Assuntos Regulatórios Packaging, contribuindo com projetos estratégicos e colaborando para a criação de novas ferramentas e produtos. Se você é curioso(a), gosta de inovação e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza o desenvolvimento profissional, essa oportunidade é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando o 2º ou 3º ano de Química ou Engenharia Química;
  • Conhecimentos em informática (Pacote Office);
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável);
  • Perfil proativo, com vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.


Principais Atividades:

  • Avaliação de fórmulas para a preparação de Ficha com Dados de Segurança (português, espanhol e inglês) para os produtos de linha no sistema DATASUL.
  • Avaliação de fórmulas para a preparação de Ficha com Dados de Segurança (português, espanhol e inglês) para as fórmulas experimentais e Chile – procedimento 100% manual.
  • Atualização do SharePoint de Regulatórios Global e LATAM.
  • Avaliação de substâncias ou matérias-primas presentes nas formulações dos produtos através do sistema DATASUL.
  • Atualização de informações no sistema DATASUL que possam impactar as Ficha com Dados de Segurança, conforme necessário.
  • Verificação da publicação de novas regulamentações: Anvisa e Mercosul, consultando o Diário Oficial.
  • Preparação dos documentos, preparo e envio de amostras (chapas de aço inoxidável) para laboratórios terceirizados para testes de migração.
  • Fornecer dados do DATASUL de acordo com a substância em uso e seus impactos do ponto de vista regulatório.
  • Atualizar as planilhas para controle de dados nas plataformas global e local - cartas e declarações, testes, Ficha com Dados de Segurança).
  • Preparar um projeto especial alinhado às necessidades da equipe regulatória da América Latina.
  • Levantamento de Dados Mensais (cartas e declarações e Ficha com Dados de Segurança).



Bolsa-Auxílio e Benefícios:

Bolsa-Auxílio: de acordo com o ano em curso na faculdade;

Benefícios: Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Refeição no Local, Vale Transporte ou Ônibus Fretado.

title: Analista I Desenvolvimento de Software | Python/IA
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO

Estamos em busca de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) júnior para integrar nosso time e

atuar na melhoria de sistemas de crawling de sites e na criação e manutenção de sistemas

de antifraude, utilizando Inteligência Artificial.

  • Manter e expandir sistemas de crawlers de sites utilizando tecnologias tradicionais e/ou de
  • inteligência artificial com LLMs;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de IA aplicadas a antifraude;
  • Trabalhar com LLMs para análise, classificação, extração e interpretação de informações;
  • Auxiliar na criação e melhoria de prompts e fluxos de IA generativa;
  • Atuar em projetos de OCR, visão computacional e validação de documentos;
  • Apoiar na análise de evidências e padrões relacionados a fraudes;
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs simples para integração das soluções;
  • Executar testes, validações e análises básicas dos modelos;
  • Documentar funcionalidades e apoiar na organização das entregas técnicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA

  • Conhecimento em Python;
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning;
  • Interesse ou experiência inicial com LLMs e IA Generativa;
  • Conhecimento básico em containers (Ex.: Docker);
  • Familiaridade com bibliotecas como: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow ou similares;
  • Noções de consumo/criação de APIs;
  • Conhecimento básico em Git e controle de versão.
  • Noções de crawlers de sites e ferramentas relacionadas: Scrapy, Selenium/Playwright, BeautifulSoup, etc;


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Interesse ou experiência em sistemas de antifraude;
  • Experiência com crawlers avançados (ex: com proteções de captcha, proxies, sites dinâmicos com Javascript, etc);
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas Linux;
  • Conhecimentos de código limpo e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos em testes de unidade e integração;
  • Noções de prompt engineering;
  • Conhecimento básico em OCR, processamento de imagens ou documentos;
  • Experiência acadêmica ou prática com projetos de IA;
  • Curiosidade sobre análise de padrões, anomalias e validações automatizadas.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Vaga para desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile voltados a produtos digitais, com consumo de APIs complexas, dados em tempo real, integração com hardware e dispositivos, uso de mapas e geolocalização e atuação em aplicações operacionais e críticas.

  • Implementação de funcionalidades com mapas e geolocalização
  • Atuação em apps operacionais e críticos
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade
  • Gerenciamento de estado, ciclo de vida e comunicação assíncrona
  • Integração com times de backend, frontend web, hardware e produto


STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • React Native
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • Consumo de APIs REST
  • Comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware / dispositivos
  • Uso de mapas e geolocalização
  • Conceitos de performance mobile
  • Versionamento com Git


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou Italiano a nível de conversação serão considerados um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com Android nativo (Kotlin)
  • Experiência com apps publicados em loja
  • Vivência com aplicações operacionais ou críticas
  • Integração com dispositivos físicos


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento mobile
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Facilidade para resolver problemas complexos
  • Atenção a impacto em produção, estabilidade e desempenho

  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de carreira estruturado

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with strong backend expertise and solid experience in API integrations to join our team. This role will focus on building and maintaining integrations with Shopify Fulfillment Services, designing robust event-driven systems, and ensuring high reliability across distributed components.


If you are passionate about scalable architectures, clean code, and solving complex integration challenges, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build internal system adapters and perform complex data mapping
  • Implement webhook processing and event-driven workflows
  • Design robust error handling, retry strategies, and idempotent processes
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with the team on API design, architecture decisions, and technical improvements
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues with a proactive mindset


✅ Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with Python development
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of webhook architecture and event handling
  • Experience with OAuth authentication flows
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify experience is highly preferred)
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and message queues
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English communication skills

Vivência no fluxos de departamento de Engenharia

Boa comunicação;

Organização;

Pensamento crítico

Comprometimento com o aprendizado contínuo

Refeição no local

Assistência médica e odontológica

Convênio farmácia

Seguro de vida

title: SR Desenvolvimento .NET
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos profissional de nível sênior especializado no desenvolvimento .NET e experiência na execução de testes que tenha disponibilidade para atuar em um projeto pontual (temporário).


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e migração de aplicações back-end e integrações de sistemas
  • Participar da análise técnica de soluções e estimativas
  • Garantir qualidade e boas práticas de codificação
  • Apoiar na construção de testes e integração contínua


Requisitos:

  • Vivência com .NET (desejável .NET Framework e/ou .NET Core)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração contínua como Jenkins
  • Controle de versionamento com GitLab
  • Integrações e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com IA será um diferencial
  • Experiência em arquitetura e migração de soluções para cloud, com foco em Azure, incluindo Azure Functions, AKS e Logic Apps

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Consultor(a) SAP SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA FI SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA MM SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PM-PP SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA SD-CS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA CO SR


Sobre as oportunidades:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado.
  • Prazo: 12 meses renováveis.
  • Atividades: Atuação em projeto de conversão para SAP S/4HANA , conduzindo análise de impacto, adequação e estabilização de processos nos módulos FI, CO, MM, SD-CS, PS, PP e PM . Responsável por: Liderar diagnóstico de impactos da conversão (processos, dados e integrações); Garantir integração end-to-end entre áreas financeira, controladoria, suprimentos, vendas, projetos, manutenção e produção; Revisar e estabilizar processos ponta a ponta; Planejar e executar testes (unitários, integrados, UAT e regressão); Atuar em cutover e hypercare, assegurando consistência de saldos, estoques, custos e faturamento; Garantir compliance contábil/fiscal e integridade de dados mestres; Suportar estabilização pós-go-live, atuando na resolução de incidentes críticos e governança de correções.
  • Local: Atuação remota com solicitações de idas esporádicas sob demanda.
  • Despesas: Reembolsáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA no módulo de atuação (FI, CO, MM, SD, PS, PM ou PP).
  • Participação em ao menos um projeto de conversão ECC → S/4HANA ou rollout.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos de S/4HANA no respectivo módulo (simplificações, mudanças de processos e dados).
  • Experiência com testes (unitário, integrado, UAT) e validação de consistência (saldos, estoques, custos ou documentos, conforme módulo).
  • Vivência em cutover e suporte pós-go-live (hypercare).
  • Familiaridade com Fiori e integrações com módulos correlatos.

Desejável:

  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro - RJ

SOBRE A VAGA

Vaga para desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile voltados a produtos digitais, com consumo de APIs complexas, dados em tempo real, integração com hardware e dispositivos, uso de mapas e geolocalização e atuação em aplicações operacionais e críticas.

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos mobile Android e iOS

  • Integração com APIs REST e comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware e dispositivos
  • Implementação de funcionalidades com mapas e geolocalização
  • Atuação em apps operacionais e críticos
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade
  • Gerenciamento de estado, ciclo de vida e comunicação assíncrona
  • Integração com times de backend, frontend web, hardware e produto


STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • React Native
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • Consumo de APIs REST
  • Comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware / dispositivos
  • Uso de mapas e geolocalização
  • Conceitos de performance mobile
  • Versionamento com Git


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou Italiano a nível de conversação serão considerados um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com Android nativo (Kotlin)
  • Experiência com apps publicados em loja
  • Vivência com aplicações operacionais ou críticas
  • Integração com dispositivos físicos


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento mobile
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Facilidade para resolver problemas complexos
  • Atenção a impacto em produção, estabilidade e desempenho

Regime de contratação: CLT Presencial

Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Plano de saúde Unimed
  • Plano odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de carreira estruturado


CANDIDATURA

Os interessados devem enviar currículo para o e-mail , informando no assunto a área de interesse.

Duration: 3 months initially (strong extension potential)

Day Rate: £250 (B2B Contractor - Approx. $340)

Location: Remote (UK / EU Time Zones Preferred)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and optimise distributed data processing systems
  • Build high-throughput event pipelines in Go and/or Python
  • Work within a large Data Build Tools instance transforming data in a warehouse
  • Improve system performance and scalability
  • Collaborate closely with the Technical Lead and small engineering team
  • Contribute to architectural decisions for a new distributed system


Required Experience:

  • Strong experience building distributed systems
  • Proven experience processing high-volume event data
  • Production-level Go and/or Python experience
  • Strong SQL skills (data warehousing context)
  • Experience working with Data Build Tools
  • Ability to work independently and deliver value quickly
  • Experience in advertising, analytics, or large-scale data platforms is advantageous

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Purchasing Agent - Buyer
description:
Please note that the role requires Excellent communication skills in English (both written & oral).


Please share the resumes in English only.


BASIC PURPOSE: Support and expedite supply chain operations, process orders, and execute sourcing activities for orders. Manage all purchases for assigned vessels and processing on POs accordingly.


POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Support operations for the purchasing process, primarily requisitioning and ordering.
  • Ensure all requisitions are compliant with the company’s policies.
  • Expedite inventory and direct charge purchase orders for multiple ships as required and in accordance with purchasing procedures.
  • Complete the processing of manual purchase orders.
  • Ensure all necessary approvals are documented, the orders are placed, and shipments are delivered on time.
  • Perform sourcing activities and get quotes on all items for POs for assigned vessels.
  • Ensure the items and prices are accurately listed in the PO.
  • Work with the sourcing team(s) and suppliers to get quotes on new items.
  • Ensure that all users, approvals, and filters are set up in accordance with the company’s procurement policies.
  • Serve as the help desk for users relating to the purchasing tools employed.
  • Coordinate processes with the accounts payable function to facilitate the enforcement of established policies.
  • Support implementation and management of ongoing operations for eProcurement solutions.
  • Regularly meet with the management to seek ongoing direction, coaching,and support as required.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Business or other related field of study; or any equivalent combination of experience and skills.


EXPERIENCE: Minimum 1 year of experience with procurement operations, ERP (e.g. PeopleSoft), eProcurement, eCatalog, contract management, eRFX, and eAuction strategies and technologies.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Good teamwork skills to work with other company departments to plan and execute enhancement, upgrade, and ongoing deployment of the above technologies.
  • Strong facilitation skills to communicate and collaborate with stakeholders across the company to implement Procure-to-Pay (P2P) technologies.
  • Demonstrated success in gathering data, conducting analyses, and generating high-quality outputs.
  • Experience with process, quality control, and workflow management and design preferred. Numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to multi-task and problem solve.
  • An understanding of leading P2P technology practices and trends (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba), general experience of network administration preferred.
  • Experience with ERP and P2P systems (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba, PeopleSoft), proficiency in Microsoft suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).


To Executive Search Firms & Staffing Agencies: NCLH does not accept unsolicited resumes from any agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered NCLH property, and NCLH will not be obligated to pay a referral fee. This includes resumes submitted directly to Hiring Managers without contacting the NCLH Human Resources Talent Acquisition Department.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior / AI CoE Lead para atuar na construção do Centro de Excelência em IA.

O profissional será responsável por estruturar a plataforma corporativa de IA, garantindo escalabilidade, governança, segurança e controle de custos, acelerando a adoção de GenAI na organização.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolver CLI corporativo para invocação de agentes.

Criar runtime de agentes e registry de skills.

Desenvolver LLM Gateway corporativo com controle de uso e rate limiting.

Garantir versionamento de agentes e skills.

Implementar logging estruturado de prompts e outputs.

Implementar mecanismos de auditoria, filtros de input/output e controle de dados sensíveis.

Apoiar a definição de tiers de uso (n8n) e stack oficial de modelos.

Criar métricas executivas de uso de IA, telemetria e observabilidade.

Integrar soluções com Kubernetes e CI/CD a nível arquitetural.


Requisitos

Inglês avançado para comunicação global.

Forte experiência em Back-end com Node.js ou Python.

Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de APIs, sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura multi-tenant.

Experiência prática com autenticação (OAuth, JWT, RBAC).

Experiência com observabilidade (logs e métricas).

Domínio de versionamento semântico e testes automatizados.

Perfil AI-Native mandatório (uso diário de Copilot, Cursor, Codeium ou similares).


Diferenciais

Experiência com LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).

Experiência com RAG.

Conhecimento sobre prompt injection.

Experiência em colocar GenAI em produção.

Implementação de controle de custos e criação de abstrações reutilizáveis.


Formato de trabalho: Hibrido 2 a 3 dias em Alphaville.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Location: Brazil (Remote)


**Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered**

Telesign connects, protects and proactively defends companies, customers and the digital interactions between them. With powerful AI that delivers identity with speed, accuracy and global reach, we enable Continuous Trust. Empowering companies to transact, communicate and engage with their customers free of fear, Continuous Trust makes the promise of the digital economy possible.


Sales Development Representative position is a position within Telesign’s Market Development department. SDR is a coordination point between Market Development and Sales, and responsible for opportunity generation and hand-off to Sales. SDR is the first contact between a potential customer and Telesign and is responsible for shaping Telesign’s sales development strategy in the assigned region.


Key Responsibilities


  • Work closely with Market Research team to Identify key companies within the assigned region and key people within target accounts
  • Generate emails for Outreach.io, make cold-calls to map and penetrate accounts on the assigned Bounty List
  • Demonstrating a clear understanding of sales processes and product and service value propositions
  • Actively seeking out new potential client accounts and making the first contact with those accounts to generate interest
  • Generate sales appointments and directly influence sales pipeline
  • Lead management and CRM activities using Salesforce.com
  • Develop and maintain territory plan from your assigned geography
  • Weekly reporting on territory updates, industry trends, regional insights, competition news, etc
  • Participation in Sales Development projects that have wider impact on Market Development, Sales and other teams in the company
  • Actively contribute, build and innovate TeleSign’s sales development program and processes


Essential Requirements


  • Fluent spoken and written Portuguese , English (C1 level) and Spanish is a Plus.
  • University degree (business, economics, political and social sciences, linguistics and similar)
  • 2 - 4 years on similar business development or sales related positions
  • Lead generation, account management, or sales experience (SaaS sales a plus, but not required)
  • Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) user
  • Strong time management skills – ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment;
  • Strong drive to achieve results with minimal supervision
  • Strong organizational skills and proactive, innovative approach;
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills;
  • Desire to be in technology sales and have a growth mindset for a long-term career in sales
  • The passion and drive to deliver an exceptional level of achievements;
  • Interest in learning about new communication technologies
  • Experience of CRM (especially Salesforce.com) is a plus

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Vendas (sem equipe) para liderar a gestão de contas estratégicas e regionais em um momento de transformação para um modelo comercial mais consultivo, orientado por dados e com forte governança .

  • Superior completo (pós-graduação será um diferencial)

  • Domínio de Excel, análise de dados e ferramentas como Scantech

  • Desenvolver novos canais e mapear concorrência
  • Realizar visitas estratégicas e apoiar negociações
  • Planejar ações integradas com Marketing e Trade Marketing
  • Gerir pipeline, oportunidades e planos de execução

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer – Distributed Systems

Duration: 3 months initially (strong extension potential)

  • Production-level Go and/or Python experience
  • Strong SQL skills (data warehousing context)
  • Experience working with Data Build Tools
  • Ability to work independently and deliver value quickly
  • Experience in advertising, analytics, or large-scale data platforms is advantageous
